verdict.rationale: Warp here is a hosted HR and payroll SaaS, and self-hosting is a fair question for that kind of product. The evidence only documents a hosted REST API, SDKs, webhooks, an MCP integration and a Homebrew CLI client. None of it shows a self-hostable or on-prem deployment of the core platform, and a locally installed API client is not self-hosting the product.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
